svg.title: higgsfield-scraper — container view of one run
svg.desc: Numbered data flow: CLI and run manager start a run; the scraper spider requests Higgsfield JSON APIs through auth and archive middlewares; parsers turn responses into entities; pipelines archive, validate, dedup and export them into a timestamped run folder.
svg.text: higgsfield-scraper · container view of one run
Data flows left → right. Numbers give the order of events. Same machinery for every scraper (pricing, community, catalog, projects, blog).

svg.text: Double-headed arrows = request + response. Only GET requests are sent; mutating endpoints (buy, vote, generate…) are never called.
